g.text: GDHUB-133 — one curator pipeline: the AI writes it, a human says it
Shared — the platform, the same for both curators

text.tspan: the same verdict and note fields, the same page for the author
picture N−1 → N (day 1 → day 28 for the verdict)
+ what the artifacts and devlog media show
2. Read through four lenses, weighed by the stage
+ direction to the checkpoint goal and to the stage goal:
focus, task advice; day 15: the last change to the tasks
Verdict = the same read over the whole run
+ the four directions in a row
Sprint review, the day after a sprint ends
Brief, the night before a call
steps 1–3 as the AI read them
in the same shape: lenses, directions, proposals
a warning on each task without evidence
Chooses the verdict, writes the note
free choice, a draft until sent

g.text: Steps 1–3 and the verdict's read are one code path; only the voice differs
The author's Review tab reads the same whoever the curator is
The AI's verdict is bound by the evidence rule; a human's is warned, never blocked
Idle is decided in code from an empty difference; the other three directions by the read
A sprint's picture is written before its review; the sprint 4 review before the verdict
A lens the call did not cover stays empty; the curator confirms the directions after the call
The lab at /dev/ai-curator runs the whole pipeline on the same code: pictures 0–4 → reviews 1–4 → verdict, and call notes from a transcript
